visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man wearing a white t-shirt and a dark blue cap backwards, standing in a brightly lit hotel hallway next to a room door numbered 417. He has a slight beard and is looking directly at the camera with a casual expression, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. (2) The scene shifts to a graphic map of Switzerland with a red pin over Lausanne; the background shows a scenic view of a city at dusk with mountains in the far distance under a clear sky. (3) The man walks into a spacious, well-lit hotel suite with two large beds, beige carpets with a geometric pattern, and several windows draped with patterned curtains. He moves through the living area, which includes armchairs and a small round table, towards a glass balcony door. (4) He steps onto a balcony with a black metal railing, revealing a stunning wide-angle view of a lake and the Alps under a bright, sunny sky. He points enthusiastically at the landscape. (5) The man enters a modern, marble-tiled bathroom and focuses the camera on a white flush plate on the wall that bears the 'GEBERIT' logo. He points to it multiple times. (6) A montage follows showing various bathroom settings in different locations—near the Matterhorn, in a spa, and in a factory—all featuring Geberit plumbing fixtures and flush plates. The man appears in different outfits, including a yellow jacket and purple beanie, consistently pointing at the brand logo.

It begins by showcasing the luxury and high cost of living in Lausanne, Switzerland, specifically through a hotel room tour. It then transitions into a focused promotion of Geberit bathroom products, demonstrating their ubiquity and reliability in Swiss infrastructure by showing them in various iconic and public locations.
